original_issue.description: Rebind current maximum terminal flows and verify exact40percent factor.

sources.quote: 2. Space air diffusion design for minimum load condition

• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser with a minimum turn down ratio of 
40%. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.

resolution: Only minimum-flow arithmetic conditional on the current maximum-flow allocation is resolved;all80IDs independently checked at0.4. Geometry/layout,actual loads,product throw,ADPI and installation stay separate unresolved obligations.

dependency_change.basis: Arithmetic can be reviewed conditional on the actual passing allocation without accepting physical layout.
